description:
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Gyre Sage.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Gyre Sage.
Repeat.

uses.name: Gyre Sage
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with two +1/+1 counters on it
